# anthropic_claude_tag_slack_channel (Resource)

Experimental. Sets up a Slack channel for Claude Tag (Claude in Slack) and manages its settings (`/v1/organizations/claude_tag/slack_channels`). The Slack workspace must already be connected in claude.ai. If the channel is already set up, create adopts it. Settings left unset are cleared so they are inherited.

Destroy only removes the channel from Terraform state. The channel keeps its settings and history. To turn Claude off, set `enabled = false`. To delete the channel, use claude.ai or the API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Set a Slack channel up for Claude Tag. The Slack workspace must already be
# connected to the organization in claude.ai.
resource "anthropic_claude_tag_slack_channel" "example" {
  slack_workspace_id = "T00000000"
  slack_channel_id   = "C00000000"

  enabled      = true
  model        = "claude-example-model"
  guest_policy = "restrict"
  reply_mode   = "mention_only"
  instructions = <<-EOT
    Answer briefly and link to sources.
  EOT
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slack_channel_id` (String) Slack's own channel identifier (`C...` or `G...`), not the Claude Tag channel `id`.
- `slack_workspace_id` (String) Slack's own workspace identifier (`T...`), not the Claude Tag workspace `id`.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Claude is on. `true` on a channel turns Claude on even when its workspace stores `false`. Null means not stored here (inherited).
- `environment_id` (String) Environment Claude's sessions run in (`env_...`) or a self-hosted runner pool (`ccpool_...`). Null means not stored here (inherited).
- `guest_policy` (String) What Claude does while a Slack guest is in the channel: `allow`, `restrict`, or `channel_only`. Null means not stored here (inherited).
- `instructions` (String) Instructions for Claude, up to 8,192 characters. Instructions add up across settings levels, broadest first. Null means none stored here.
- `model` (String) Model identifier or model line name Claude uses. Null means not stored here (inherited).
- `reply_mode` (String) How Claude takes part in the channel: `automatic`, `mention_only`, `always_awake`, or `thread`. A stored reply mode can be changed but never cleared. Removing it from the configuration keeps the current value. Null means none stored yet, and Claude follows the mode chosen in Slack or `automatic`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the channel was set up.
- `id` (String) Claude Tag channel identifier (`slch_...`).
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the last change to Claude Tag's record of the channel.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the Claude Tag channel ID (slch_...).
terraform import anthropic_claude_tag_slack_channel.example slch_00000000
```
